title: A Semester for the Group Chat
author: Tamsin Whitlock
blurb: Wendell Oyelaran, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
